dedupe_keys.name: 2006 commercial vehicle survey equivalent single axle load

description: This Ontario Ministry of Transportation dataset assigns equivalent single axle loads to road-network links using axle weights collected in the 2006 Commercial Vehicle Survey. The source distinguishes ESAL 06 for the 2006 loading and ESAL 26 for the 2026 forecast. Values are expanded to represent annual average daily truck traffic on each network segment. These are loading measures for road infrastructure, with observed-survey and forecast attributes kept distinct. The provider lists two ZIP distributions but does not state their internal file format, geometry type, forecasting method or exact survey dates in the inspected description. Coverage is the Ontario survey network; completeness outside that network is unknown. Access is through the native metadata page and its listed distributions under the Open Government Licence–Ontario. Charges and payload restrictions were not independently established. Related records contain station traffic counts and assigned commercial flows from the same survey; those descriptions do not establish this axle-load resource as an existing component. No ZIP or dataset values were obtained.
